code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rbar = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    cbar = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h)))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]

                out[i][j] = 3
            else:

    return out
